divergence_vs_gemini.detail: Gemini captains a defender the squad does not even own, on a one-week xpts spike (10.32). This breaks the locked v7 protocol on three counts: (1) the captain pool is nailed PREMIUM outfielders (price >= 7.5), and a 5.7m DEF is not in it; (2) the rule is season cum_pts leader, not this-week's xpts leader — 7 holdout rounds proved every xpts/form/matchup variant loses to cum_pts on unseen data; (3) a defender's captaincy ceiling is structurally capped (no goal-volume tail) — Haaland's p90 is 22.46 doubled vs a CS-dependent 13. Noted as a divergence, not adopted.
